items.prompt: A bulb is connected to a cell, but one wire is disconnected. What happens to the current in this circuit?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ଗୋଟିଏ ବଲ୍ବକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସେଲ୍ ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ତାର ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ଅଛି। ଏହି ପରିପଥରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା କ’ଣ ହେବ?

options.text: The current grows continuously inside the wire.
options.textOdiaDraft: ତାର ଭିତରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ଲଗାତାର ବଢ଼ିବ।

options.text: The circuit is open, so a continuous current does not flow.
options.textOdiaDraft: ପରିପଥ ଖୋଲା ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ ନିରନ୍ତର ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେବ ନାହିଁ।

options.text: The cell pushes current across the air gap.
options.textOdiaDraft: ସେଲ୍ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରାକୁ ବାୟୁର ଫାଙ୍କ ଦେଇ ପଠାଇବ।

options.text: The bulb uses up the current before it reaches the gap.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବଲ୍ବ ତାର ଫାଙ୍କରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରାକୁ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିଦିଏ।

items.explanation: A steady current needs a closed conducting path. An open wire breaks that path.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ନିରନ୍ତର ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପାଇଁ ବନ୍ଦ ଚାଳକ ପଥ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। ତାରର ଫାଙ୍କ ସେହି ପଥକୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଦିଏ।
items.remediation: Trace the path from one battery terminal through the bulb and back to the other terminal. Mark the exact break in the path.

bridge.everydayOdia: ତାର ମଝିରେ ଫାଙ୍କ ରହିଲେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଚାଲିବାର ପୂରା ରାସ୍ତା ରହେ ନାହିଁ।

misconceptions.description: Belief that current builds up continuously in an open part of a circuit.
Belief that current can flow across a physical break without a conducting path.
Belief that a bulb or other component uses up current as it passes through.

items.prompt: Why does a bulb go out when a switch opens a simple series circuit?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ସରଳ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ ପରିପଥରେ ସ୍ୱିଚ୍ ଖୋଲିଲେ ବଲ୍ବ କାହିଁକି ନିଭିଯାଏ?

options.text: The continuous path is broken, so current stops in the circuit.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ପଥ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ପରିପଥରେ ନିରନ୍ତର ଧାରା ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।

options.text: The battery permanently loses all its energy immediately.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବ୍ୟାଟେରୀ ତୁରନ୍ତ ତାର ସମସ୍ତ ଶକ୍ତି ହରାଏ।

options.text: The bulb stores all the current inside its glass.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବଲ୍ବ ନିଜ ଭିତରେ ସମସ୍ତ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରାକୁ ସଞ୍ଚୟ କରେ।

options.text: The switch turns current into air.
options.textOdiaDraft: ସ୍ୱିଚ୍ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରାକୁ ବାୟୁରେ ପରିଣତ କରେ।

items.explanation: Opening the switch breaks the conducting loop. The cell can still have stored chemical energy.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ସ୍ୱିଚ୍ ଖୋଲିଲେ ଚାଳକ ପଥ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ। ସେଲ୍‌ରେ ରାସାୟନିକ ଶକ୍ତି ତଥାପି ରହିପାରେ।
items.remediation: Compare a complete loop and a loop with an open switch. Identify whether a continuous path exists in each diagram.

bridge.everydayOdia: ସ୍ୱିଚ୍ ଖୋଲିଲେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଯିବାର ପଥ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ବଲ୍ବ ନିଭିଯାଏ।

misconceptions.description: Belief that opening a switch instantly removes all energy stored chemically in the cell.
Belief that current is stored inside a bulb when the circuit opens.
Belief that opening a switch transforms current into air.

items.prompt: When current passes through a resistor, which statement best describes energy?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେବାବେଳେ ଶକ୍ତି ବିଷୟରେ କେଉଁ ବକ୍ତବ୍ୟଟି ଠିକ୍?

options.text: Energy is destroyed by the resistor.
Energy is transferred to the surroundings, often as thermal energy.
options.textOdiaDraft: ଶକ୍ତି ପରିବେଶକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଏ, ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ତାପ ଶକ୍ତି ଭାବରେ।

options.text: The resistor creates energy from nothing.
options.textOdiaDraft: ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ କିଛି ନଥିବାରୁ ନୂଆ ଶକ୍ତି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।

options.text: The current disappears and energy has no destination.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ହୋଇଯାଏ ଏବଂ ଶକ୍ତି କେଉଁଠିକୁ ଯାଏ ନାହିଁ।

items.explanation: Energy is transferred, not created or destroyed; a resistor can transfer electrical energy to thermal energy.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ଶକ୍ତି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କିମ୍ବା ନଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଶକ୍ତିକୁ ତାପ ଶକ୍ତି ସହିତ ଅନ୍ୟ ରୂପକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତର କରିପାରେ।
items.remediation: Draw an energy-transfer arrow from the cell to the resistor and label the useful and thermal transfers relevant to the example.

bridge.everydayOdia: ଶକ୍ତି ନଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ; ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟ ରୂପକୁ ବଦଳେ କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ୟଠାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ।

misconceptions.description: Belief that energy ceases to exist inside a resistor or other component.
Belief that a resistor or component creates energy from nothing.
Belief that the energy transfer has no destination or does not occur.

items.prompt: A resistor becomes warm while current flows. What is the best explanation?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେବାବେଳେ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଗରମ ହୁଏ। ଏହାର ଉତ୍ତମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କ’ଣ?

options.text: The resistor creates new energy.
Energy is transferred electrically and some becomes thermal energy.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଶକ୍ତି ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ଏହାର କିଛି ଅଂଶ ତାପ ଶକ୍ତି ହୁଏ।

options.text: Energy ceases to exist inside the resistor.
options.textOdiaDraft: ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଭିତରେ ଶକ୍ତି ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନଷ୍ଟ ହୋଇଯାଏ।

options.text: The battery's current is stored permanently in the resistor.
options.textOdiaDraft: ବ୍ୟାଟେରୀର ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଭିତରେ ସବୁଦିନ ପାଇଁ ସଞ୍ଚୟ ହୁଏ।

items.explanation: A resistor transfers energy to its surroundings; the warming is evidence of thermal energy transfer.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକର ଉଷ୍ଣ ହେବା ଦେଖାଏ ଯେ ଶକ୍ତିର କିଛି ଅଂଶ ତାପ ଶକ୍ତି ଭାବରେ ପରିବେଶକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହେଉଛି।
items.remediation: Explain where the energy starts and where it goes. Do not describe the current itself as being consumed.

bridge.everydayOdia: ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଗରମ ହେଲେ ତାହାର ଅର୍ଥ କିଛି ଶକ୍ତି ତାପ ଭାବେ ଚାରିପାଖକୁ ଯାଉଛି।

misconceptions.description: Belief that a resistor or component creates energy from nothing.
Belief that energy ceases to exist inside a resistor or other component.
Belief that a component stores current permanently.

items.prompt: For a metal wire at constant temperature, what happens to the current if the voltage across it doubles while its resistance stays constant?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ଏକ ଧାତୁ ତାରର ତାପମାତ୍ରା ସ୍ଥିର ରହିଲେ, ତାରର ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ସ୍ଥିର ଥିବାବେଳେ ତାହାର ଦୁଇ ମୁଣ୍ଡର ଭୋଲ୍ଟେଜ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ହେଲେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା କିପରି ବଦଳିବ?

options.text: The current becomes half as large.
The current doubles.
The current stays the same.
The resistance must double automatically.

items.explanation: For a conductor obeying Ohm’s law at constant temperature, I = V/R. With R unchanged, doubling V doubles I.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ଓମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନିୟମ ଅନୁସାରେ ତାପମାତ୍ରା ସ୍ଥିର ଥିଲେ I = V/R। ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ବଦଳିନଥିଲେ ଭୋଲ୍ଟେଜ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ହେଲେ ଧାରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ହୁଏ।
items.remediation: Write I = V/R, keep R fixed, and compare the expressions before and after the voltage doubles.

bridge.everydayOdia: ଭୋଲ୍ଟେଜ୍ ବଢ଼ିଲେ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ସେହିପରି ରହିଲେ ଧାରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଅନୁପାତରେ ବଢ଼େ।

misconceptions.description: Belief that current decreases when voltage increases while resistance is fixed.
Belief that current is unchanged when voltage increases and resistance is fixed.
Belief that resistance automatically doubles whenever voltage doubles.

items.prompt: A 6 V potential difference is applied across a 3 Ω resistor. Assuming Ohm’s law applies, what current flows?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ୩ Ω ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକର ଦୁଇ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ୬ V ବିଭବାନ୍ତର ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଓମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନିୟମ ଲାଗୁ ହେଲେ କେତେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ଧାରା ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେବ?

options.text: 2 A
3 A

items.explanation: Ohm’s law gives I = V/R = 6/3 = 2 A.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ଓମ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନିୟମ ଅନୁସାରେ I = V/R = ୬/୩ = ୨ A।
items.remediation: State the formula, substitute volts and ohms, and check that the unit is amperes.

bridge.everydayOdia: ଧାରା ହେଉଛି ଭୋଲ୍ଟେଜ୍‌କୁ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧରେ ଭାଗ କରି ମିଳୁଥିବା ମାନ।

misconceptions.description: Multiplies voltage and resistance instead of dividing voltage by resistance.
Uses resistance divided by voltage to calculate current.
Confuses the numerical resistance value with the current.

items.prompt: Two 6 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is their equivalent resistance for ideal resistors?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ଦୁଇଟି ୬ Ω ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ଭାବେ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଆଦର୍ଶ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ପାଇଁ ସମୁଦାୟ ସମତୁଲ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ କେତେ?

options.text: 6 Ω
3 Ω
0 Ω

items.explanation: For two equal resistors R in parallel, the equivalent resistance is R/2. Here 6 Ω / 2 = 3 Ω.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ସମାନ ମୂଲ୍ୟର ଦୁଇଟି R ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳରେ ଥିଲେ ସମତୁଲ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ R/୨ ହୁଏ। ଏଠାରେ ୬ Ω / ୨ = ୩ Ω।
items.remediation: Draw two branches and recall that adding a parallel branch lowers equivalent resistance; calculate for two equal branches.

bridge.everydayOdia: ସମାନ୍ତରାଳରେ ଆଉ ଏକ ପଥ ଯୋଡ଼ିଲେ ସମୁଦାୟ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଶାଖାର ପ୍ରତିରୋଧଠାରୁ କମ୍ ହୁଏ।

misconceptions.description: Adds parallel resistances as though they were connected in series.
Assumes the equivalent resistance of equal parallel branches stays equal to one branch.
Belief that any parallel connection has zero equivalent resistance.

items.prompt: Two resistors of 2 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in series. What is the equivalent resistance?
items.promptOdiaDraft: ୨ Ω ଓ ୩ Ω ମୂଲ୍ୟର ଦୁଇଟି ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ ସଂଯୋଗରେ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ସମତୁଲ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ କେତେ?

options.text: 6 Ω
3 Ω
5 Ω

items.explanation: For resistors connected in series, equivalent resistance is the sum: 2 Ω + 3 Ω = 5 Ω.
items.explanationOdiaDraft: ଶ୍ରେଣୀ ସଂଯୋଗରେ ସମତୁଲ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରତିରୋଧଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଯୋଗ: ୨ Ω + ୩ Ω = ୫ Ω।
items.remediation: Label the current path through each resistor and add their resistances for a series connection.

misconceptions.description: Uses a parallel-resistance calculation for a series circuit.
Multiplies resistances instead of adding them for a series connection.
Uses only the largest resistor rather than combining all series resistances.
